verified_database.claim: James Webb Space Telescope discovered oldest and most distant galaxies in the early universe.
verified_database.verdict_explanation: Astronomers and NASA published verified spectroscopic data confirming high-redshift galaxies formed within 300-400 million years after the Big Bang.

verified_database.claim: COVID-19 vaccines contain programmable 5G microchips or biometric tracking devices.
verified_database.verdict_explanation: Extensive laboratory testing and peer-reviewed pharmaceutical documentation confirm vaccines contain mRNA or viral vectors and lipids, with no electronic components.
verified_database.source: World Health Organization (WHO) & Reuters Fact Check

verified_database.claim: Drinking boiled lemon water and hot water cures cancer and destroys all viruses immediately.
verified_database.verdict_explanation: Medical oncologists and health institutes verify that while citrus fruits contain antioxidants, hot lemon water cannot cure cancer or replace oncological therapies.

verified_database.claim: Reserve Bank of India Monetary Policy Committee decided to maintain repo rate unchanged at 6.5 percent.
verified_database.verdict_explanation: The Reserve Bank of India officially announced in its Monetary Policy resolution that the repo rate remains fixed at 6.50% to align inflation targets.
verified_database.source: Reserve Bank of India (RBI Press Release)

verified_database.claim: New Indian 2000 rupee notes contained nano-GPS tracking chips embedded inside them.
verified_database.verdict_explanation: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) confirmed that the banknotes have standard security watermarks, intaglio printing, and threads, but no electronic or satellite tracking chips.
verified_database.source: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) & Alt News

verified_database.claim: 5G mobile networks cause COVID-19 or cellular radiation weakens human immunity against viruses.
verified_database.verdict_explanation: Radiofrequency electromagnetic fields used in 5G do not interact with viruses or create viral pathogens. Biological transmission occurs via respiratory droplets.
verified_database.source: International Commission on Non-Ionizing Radiation Protection (ICNIRP) & PolitiFact

verified_database.claim: UNESCO has declared the Indian National Anthem Jana Gana Mana as the best national anthem in the world.
verified_database.verdict_explanation: UNESCO released an official clarification stating that it does not evaluate, rank, or award titles to national anthems of any country.

verified_database.claim: NASA satellite picture of India on Diwali night shows the entire country illuminated in distinct regional colors.
verified_database.verdict_explanation: The widely shared colorful image is an artistic overlay created by NOAA scientists in 2003 to illustrate population growth over a decade, not a real-time Diwali photograph.

verified_database.claim: India successfully landed Chandrayaan-3 near the south pole region of the Moon on August 23, 2023.
verified_database.verdict_explanation: Official space telemetry and global space agencies including NASA, ESA, and ISRO verified the soft landing of the Vikram lander and deployment of the Pragyan rover.

verified_database.claim: इसरो ने मौसम उपग्रह इनसैट-3डीएस का सफल प्रक्षेपण किया।
verified_database.verdict_explanation: भारतीय अंतरिक्ष अनुसंधान संगठन (ISRO) ने श्रीहरिकोटा से जीएसएलवी रॉकेट द्वारा इनसैट-3डीएस उपग्रह को सफलतापूर्वक कक्षा में स्थापित किया।
verified_database.source: ISRO आधिकारिक विज्ञप्ति & PIB फैक्ट चेक

verified_database.claim: देश में नमक की भारी कमी होने वाली है और नमक की बिक्री बंद हो जाएगी।
verified_database.verdict_explanation: उपभोक्ता मामले और खाद्य आपूर्ति मंत्रालय ने स्पष्ट किया कि देश में नमक का प्रचुर भंडार मौजूद है और नमक की कमी की बातें केवल निराधार अफवाह हैं।
verified_database.source: PIB फैक्ट चेक & Alt News Hindi

verified_database.claim: भारतीय अंतराळ संशोधन संस्थेने चंद्रयान ३ मोहीम यशस्वीपणे पूर्ण केली.
verified_database.verdict_explanation: इस्रोने चंद्राच्या दक्षिण ध्रुवावर विक्रम लँडरचे यशस्वी सॉफ्ट लँडिंग केल्याचे वैज्ञानिक पुरावे आणि थेट प्रसारणाद्वारे सिद्ध झाले आहे.

verified_database.claim: 2000 रुपयांच्या नोटेमध्ये सॅटेलाइट नॅनो जीपीएस चिप बसवण्यात आली आहे.
verified_database.verdict_explanation: भारतीय रिझर्व्ह बँकेने (RBI) स्पष्ट केले आहे की चलनामध्ये कोणतीही इलेक्ट्रॉनिक किंवा ट्रॅकिंग चिप बसवण्यात आलेली नाही.

verified_database.claim: 5जी नेटवर्क के ट्रायल से पक्षियों की सामूहिक मौत हो रही है और इंसान बीमार पड़ रहे हैं।
verified_database.verdict_explanation: दूरसंचार विभाग (DoT) और वन्यजीव विशेषज्ञों ने जांच में पाया कि पक्षियों की मौत का 5G से कोई वैज्ञानिक संबंध नहीं था, बल्कि मौसमी संक्रमण और बर्ड फ्लू था।
verified_database.source: PIB Fact Check & Alt News Hindi

verified_database.claim: Listening to 432 Hz scalar audio frequency regrows amputated human limbs in 48 hours.
verified_database.verdict_explanation: This claim originated from satirical fiction website The Onion. Human biological limb regeneration is scientifically impossible through acoustic frequencies.
